summary: Both content fixes landed and the matrix now states its conclusion; a reversed axis arrow in PowerPoint was traced to line export and fixed for every deck. Remaining items are design choices for you.

findings.issue: The y-axis arrowhead pointed down in PowerPoint and up in HTML
findings.fix: shared: PPTX lines set flipH/flipV from their direction, so arrowheads end where the Scene line ends

findings.issue: Native chart axis labels sit about 1 px lower in PowerPoint than in HTML
findings.fix: shared: calibrate native chart label placement (engine issue)

findings.issue: Content fills only the top half; the lower half is empty
findings.fix: Add a result line, logos or proof points — or accept the whitespace

findings.issue: The decision panel repeats the title in five lines and runs down to the source line
findings.fix: Shorten the decision to two lines, e.g. 'Commit €3M on 30 October'
